memories.author: D06
memories.text:
function: Independent in all activities of daily living; works full-time as a tailor; reports no difficulty with climbing stairs or prolonged standing.
cognition: Mini-Cog score 4/5 (normal); recalls three items and clock draw intact.
falls: No falls in the last 12 months; gait steady; timed up-and-go 8 seconds (normal).
medicines: 0 regular; no polypharmacy.
mood: Reports good mood, denies anxiety or depression.
carers: Self (patient).
goals: "I want to stay healthy to continue my tailoring work without fatigue."

memories.author: lab
memories.text: Serum 25-hydroxyvitamin D: 12 ng/mL (ref 30-100). Serum calcium: 9.1 mg/dL (ref 8.5-10.5). Serum phosphate: 3.0 mg/dL (ref 2.5-4.5).

memories.author: D06
memories.text: cholecalciferol 60000 IU once weekly for 8 weeks
